name: overwrite
description: Keep exactly one latest observation per stable indicator cell.

input.workload: all H5 real-revision trace observations projected by H6

state.history_policy: expire all Iceberg snapshots except the latest after the batch

invariants: final row equals the observation from the latest incoming vintage for that cell
prior observation_id values are not addressable after snapshot expiration
the same ordered H6 input produces the same logical final state
